Records.description: The general scalar one-loop 4-point (box) integral $D_0$ with four arbitrary complex internal masses and general external momenta in $D=4-2\varepsilon$ dimensions. The paper provides closed-form analytic results in terms of dilogarithms and logarithms for all kinematic configurations, including regular and singular (IR-divergent) cases.

Records.authors: Fevola, C., Mizera, S., Telen, S.
Records.description: Landau singularities of the 1-loop box (A₄) computed via principal Landau determinants.

Results.normalization: Exact all-mass box in $D=4$ with generic internal masses $m_i^2>0$: the volume of a general hyperbolic tetrahedron (Murakami--Yano / Bourjaily--Gardi--McLeod--Vergu, arXiv:1912.11067), a weight-2 polylogarithm. The $g_k$ are the three $\mathfrak{S}_4$ orbits of BGMV's lengths form, built from $r_{ij}=\hat Y_{ij}+\sqrt{\hat Y_{ij}^2-1}$ (and $\bar g_k$ their $r\to1/r$ images); the only algebraic root is $\sqrt{\det\hat Y}$, imaginary in the physical $(3,1)$ region ($\hat Y_{ij}\ge1$, $\det\hat Y<0$). The massless box $\Phi^{(1)}$ is the $m_i^2\to0$ limit. A runnable evaluator is in the copied code. Measure $\int d^4 k/(i\pi^2)\prod_e(-q_e^2+m_e^2)^{-1}$.

source.title: All-Mass n-gon Integrals in n Dimensions
source.authors: J. L. Bourjaily, E. Gardi, A. J. McLeod, C. Vergu

import.method: Closed-form hyperbolic-tetrahedron volume (Murakami-Yano, via Bourjaily-Gardi-McLeod-Vergu arXiv:1912.11067, 'lengths' form). resultCompressed verified to 12 digits against the NGon oracle at an in-region Cayley point; over-determined verification (deterministic Feynman integral, S_4-invariance, Phi^(1) anchor).
